svg.title: Proof of Progress: a data-tile illustration
svg.desc: 489 selected claims: 462 Difficult, 0 Superhuman and 27 Superhuman — provisional assessment. Monthly counts from Jan 25 to Sept 26, including zero months. Fixed overview using the dashboard default best-current assessment, including all review and verification states. Blue includes all Difficult estimates; pale purple is provisional Superhuman. Each rounded tile is one claim, in monthly clusters from left to right; no axes or visible labels are drawn. Each claim counts once using its likely category; confidence in the assessment is separate from proof verification. Latest month may be partial. Other categories remain available in the dashboard.
